question: The idea of a single citizenship in the Constitution of India was borrowed from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Kingdom.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idea of single citizenship has been followed in India by the **UK's British constitution.**
 
• **Citizens of India** have access to the most effective shape of citizenship.
 
• It's miles impossible to be each a country citizen and a citizen of the arena.
 
• This promotes patriotism with the aid of fostering solidarity throughout ethnic and cultural divides.
 
• **The Indian constitution **grants all residents of the nation single citizenship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In contrast, in the** United States**, a person is both the citizen of the United States and of the state in which he or she lives
 
• It also promotes fundamental freedoms such as the freedom to travel and live anywhere in the country.
 
• This concept of single citizenship is borrowed from the Constitution of **Great Britain.**
